dimensions.assessment: Affects state agencies, nursing schools, nursing students, and the nursing workforce through data collection and pilot initiatives.
dimensions.evidence: establish new or enhance existing State-based nursing workforce centers

dimensions.assessment: Provides grant funding for workforce research, data analysis, retention strategies, and educational program evaluations.
dimensions.evidence: Conducting comprehensive analysis of and research on... 2- and 4-year nursing education programs

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes up to $1,500,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 and 2027 from existing HRSA workforce initiative appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: may use up to $1,500,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 and 2027 for purposes of carrying out this section.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Public Health Service Act to create a 2-year grant pilot program and expand workforce analysis authority.
dimensions.evidence: carry out a 2-year pilot program to establish new or enhance existing State-based nursing workforce centers

dimensions.assessment: Limits the grant pilot program term to 2 years, utilizing funds across fiscal years 2026 and 2027.
dimensions.evidence: The term of a grant awarded under the pilot program under subsection (a) shall be 2 years.

importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a temporary 2-year pilot program for state-based nursing workforce center grants and expands HRSA health workforce research center authority.
